properties.name: spring.profiles.active
properties.description: Active Spring profile. Set via env SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE.

properties.name: sbp.auth.port
properties.description: HTTP port for the auth service. Overridden by env AUTH_PORT.

properties.name: server.servlet.context-path
properties.description: Public API base path for auth.

properties.name: management.endpoint.health.show-details
properties.description: Health endpoint detail visibility: never, when-authorized, or always.

properties.name: sbp.internal-api.base-path
properties.description: Reserved base path for internal auth APIs.

properties.name: sbp.auth.datasource.host
properties.description: PostgreSQL host. Overridden by env AUTH_DB_HOST.

properties.name: sbp.auth.datasource.port
properties.description: PostgreSQL port. Overridden by env AUTH_DB_PORT.

properties.name: sbp.auth.datasource.name
properties.description: PostgreSQL database name. Overridden by env AUTH_DB_NAME.

properties.name: sbp.auth.datasource.username
properties.description: PostgreSQL user. Overridden by env AUTH_DB_USERNAME.

properties.name: sbp.auth.datasource.password
properties.description: PostgreSQL password. Overridden by env AUTH_DB_PASSWORD.

properties.name: sbp.auth.datasource.timezone
properties.description: IANA timezone for JDBC TimeZone and Hibernate (use Asia/Kolkata). Overridden by env APP_TIMEZONE.

properties.name: spring.datasource.url
properties.description: JDBC URL built from sbp.auth.datasource.* including TimeZone query param.

properties.name: spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto
properties.description: Hibernate schema mode: update (dev) or validate (prod).

properties.name: spring.jpa.properties.hibernate.jdbc.time_zone
properties.description: Hibernate JDBC time zone; mirrors sbp.auth.datasource.timezone.

properties.name: spring.devtools.restart.enabled
properties.description: Enable DevTools restart on classpath changes (dev profile).
